intro.text: A spren on Roshar given shape by the stories people tell of Dalinar Kholin in his years as a warrior and general, before he went to the Nightwatcher.
A spren shaped by the tales of Dalinar Kholin's warrior years, who has sworn to serve Retribution as his champion.

items.text: As Dalinar crossed the Spiritual Realm, the Realm produced a copy of him as he was when he attacked the Rift. Dalinar faced the spren and Connected with it, handing it his memories and skills and showing it what he had done after the Rift was destroyed.

So many people still thought of Dalinar as the Blackthorn, and Connected him with it, that the spren took on form. After the Contest of Champions, Retribution found it in the Spiritual Realm. It pledged to serve him in his conquests beyond Roshar and became his champion: a Dalinar without the real man's pain and weakness.
